column6: Fifteen identical pencils in a column; the repetition is the range and the range is the reason to look.
Favourites is a shortlist for someone facing forty bottles; the community picked so she does not have to.
Ten percent for an email; the price of entry is data and she has already decided that is fair.
Redness photographed at pore scale; the percentage on the pack is what makes the close-up bearable.

column2: The Self-Blamer Let Off The Hook
column6: Blemishes are a natural part of the ecosystem; the ad refuses to treat her skin as a failure.
A streamer and an avatar rather than a model; the format says this is someone she follows, not a campaign.
The scent everyone's obsessed with sells a reputation, not a smell; she is buying into a consensus.
The identical frame running unchanged for months; the sentence is doing all the work.
A bath facing a forest; the product is barely present because the hour is what is being sold.
Introducing is aimed at people already in; the launch matters because the shelf is a collection.
Robe, marble, headband; the setting says spa and the product is being offered in place of one.
A vitamin bath for your skin explains by metaphor; she cannot assess the actives so she assesses the sentence.
Real reviews, real results; the word real twice is aimed at someone who assumes the category lies.
Fifty-three looks forty-three is the arithmetic; no injections is what makes it a decision she can own.
A quoted age gap plus three award seals; the number is personal and the badges make it defensible.
Three products held up together; the routine is the unit being sold, not the jar.
A compact on white with no copy; the pink lid is the brand and the pan is the decision.
Shade 5n named on screen; she is watching to see it on someone before she picks her own.
A glossy black form on grey; the finish is the entire claim and it can only be shown.
The founder holding her own product; the face is the formula and the purchase is proximity.
